# Contributing

Create a branch or fork, make your change and open a pull request against `main`.
Describe the change and how you checked it. The project owner, @crokatron,
reviews contributions and decides whether to merge or close each pull request.

Main requires a pull request and owner review. New commits dismiss old approvals;
review discussions must be resolved. Force pushes and deletion of main are blocked.
The owner may use the explicit pull-request bypass to merge their own contribution,
because authors cannot approve their own pull requests. Direct pushes are still blocked.

Never include credentials, personal configurations or real household/runtime data.
Keep original licence and attribution notices. Check the project README and manual
for dependencies, validation commands and features that are only simulated in the demo.
